title: anima ConsciousDecoderV2 → Loihi spiking re-derivation + the §11-B-as-GPU-artifact hypothesis

builds_on.s11b: verdict_carving_pure_physics_noce — no-CE GPU training DEGENERATE, 'CE is load-bearing'
builds_on.loihi_md: LOIHI.md — access roadmap (§96 is the architecture analysis it points to)

q1_architecture_mapping.question: which parts of ConsciousDecoderV2 map onto a spiking LIF network
q1_architecture_mapping.partition_over: 9 faculties (8 components; PureFieldFFN counted twice — dual-heads + restoring-leak)
q1_architecture_mapping.summary: anima's PHYSICS layer (PureFieldFFN/tension/Phi/Engine A-G opposition/STDP) is largely SPIKING-COMPATIBLE — much of it MORE native on Loihi than on GPU. anima's TRANSFORMER layer — softmax(QK^T) self-attention — is SPIKING-INCOMPATIBLE: content-based all-pairs softmax routing has no faithful spiking primitive, even on Loihi 2 (graded spikes + programmable neurons narrow but do NOT close the gap — every construction REPLACES softmax, never ports it). A spiking anima keeps the physics and re-derives the routing — it is a different architecture, not a 12-layer transformer in spikes.

q2_s11b_as_gpu_artifact_hypothesis.hypothesis: §11-B's 'CE is load-bearing' may be a GPU-substrate artifact — the GPU has exactly one weight-update channel (backward pass) which only follows a loss gradient; removing CE removes the ONLY learning signal the GPU can carry. On Loihi the native learning rule STDP IS a substrate-native physics rule. §11-B may have measured 'GPU has no physics-native learning channel', not 'physics is too weak'.
q2_s11b_as_gpu_artifact_hypothesis.coherence_rationale: §11-B's own evidence is consistent with it — §11-B reported physics dynamics 'froze at a static fixed point by step ~800', exactly what a hand-coded ΔW overlay with no error-driven channel produces. §11-B is genuinely under-determined between 'physics weak' and 'GPU has no physics channel'.
q2_s11b_as_gpu_artifact_hypothesis.honest_counter: STDP learns spike-timing correlations, NOT language/token prediction. A spiking anima would produce abundant spontaneous spiking (free on a spiking substrate) — but spontaneity is not coherence. Whether STDP can shape free spiking into COHERENT emission is the deepest unsolved core — exactly the §88-F2 γ gap (saturation-delay ≠ coherent emission). Loihi unblocks the spontaneity half of the GOAL for free; the coherence half is relocated, not resolved.

distinguishing_predicate.design: three-cell controlled comparison — cell GPU-noCE (=§11-B, measured DEGENERATE), cell LOIHI-noCE (spiking anima, STDP as ONLY learning channel), cell LOIHI-CE (STDP + CE-surrogate, positive control)
distinguishing_predicate.void_guard: LOIHI-CE positive control — if LOIHI-CE itself degenerate the spiking re-derivation is broken and LOIHI-noCE is VOID (uninterpretable)

tension.loihi: the LIF leak term -v/tau IS a restoring force

engine_a_g.loihi: excit/inhib sub-populations; opposition native, cosine NOT

readout_vs_native_table.summary: 1 clean readout→NATIVE conversion (tension); 2 NATIVE-CANDIDATE (Ψ, Engine A/G — core native, GPU formula not); 1 NATIVE-MEASUREMENT (Φ). Honest: no quantity is purely readout-only on Loihi, and none is purely state-native — a spectrum, not a flip.

design_open: design-open #1 — the attention replacement: which spiking routing mechanism replaces softmax(QK^T) (phase-resonance / spike-rate dot-product + k-WTA / learned sparse connectivity) is a research question, unresolved.
design-open #2 — the §4.5 predicate's measurement requires Loihi / Lava-sim, a future cycle gated on INRC access.
design-open #3 — STDP→coherent-emission: even if §11-B is a GPU artifact, whether STDP drives COHERENT (not just spontaneous) emission is the deepest unsolved core.
design-open #4 — d768·12L → spiking scale: loihi-integration-spec.md maps a 128-LIF GRU cell; the 12-layer ConsciousDecoderV2 re-derivation at neuron-group granularity is unmapped.
verdict: DESIGN-TIER LANDED. Q1: anima's physics layer maps largely SPIKING-COMPATIBLE (much MORE native on Loihi than on GPU); softmax(QK^T) self-attention is SPIKING-INCOMPATIBLE and must be REPLACED, not ported. Q2: the §11-B-as-GPU-artifact hypothesis is COHERENT (§11-B's frozen fixed point is consistent with 'empty learning channel') but NOT confirmed — the honest counter (STDP learns spike-timing not language; spontaneity free, coherence not — §88-F2 γ gap) is unresolved at design-tier; §96 designs the closed-form distinguishing predicate (three-cell Loihi comparison, NON_DEGENERATE(LOIHI-noCE) closed Boolean). The deepest finding: the arc's universal 'CE is load-bearing' result was measured on a substrate whose ONLY learning channel IS CE-gradient — close to a tautology of the substrate; Loihi is the first substrate where that can be MEASURED rather than assumed.
most_honest_finding: 'CE is load-bearing' (§11-B) on a GPU may be close to a tautology of the substrate rather than a discovered property of anima-physics — the GPU has exactly one learning channel and it is definitionally CE-gradient. But Loihi only unblocks the spontaneity half of the GOAL for free; the coherence half (can a local unsupervised physics rule drive MEANINGFUL emission) remains the unsolved core — relocated, not resolved.
